title: Foxes of Alberta
description: Meet Alberta's swift and red foxes and discover how they live.
overviewDescription: Explore Alberta's swift and red foxes, listen to audio clips, watch a video, then answer questions about their habitats and diets.

activity.introduction: Foxes depend on their habitats for food, water, and shelter. Explore Alberta's swift and red foxes through audio, video, and a quiz.

viewer.heading: Read and look closer
viewer.description: Open a field message or take a closer look at a fox family.

message.title: A note from the field
message.subtitle: A quiet moment on the prairie
message.body: The kits tumble through the grass while their mother watches nearby. They are learning the smells and sounds of home, one small adventure at a time.
message.preview: Read a short note about young foxes exploring their home.

image.title: A fox family
image.description: Four young foxes pause together in the warm prairie light. Staying close gives the kits a safe place to rest while they explore their surroundings.
image.alt: Four young foxes sitting together in dry grass.
image.preview: View a family of young foxes resting in the grass.

listen.heading: Listen and explore
listen.description: Play audio or video from the expedition. The media player keeps going while you explore other pages.
listen.videoDescription: Watch a video about Alberta's foxes.

song.title: Test song
song.description: Start listening to add a journal note, then play to the end to add another.

narration.title: Test narration
narration.description: A short recording. Finish it to add a journal note.

redFoxSound.title: Red fox sound
redFoxSound.description: Start listening to add a note to your journal.

quiz.heading: Test your knowledge
quiz.description: Answer questions about swift and red foxes in Alberta.

swift-fox-home.prompt: Which habitat is most closely associated with swift foxes in southeastern Alberta?
swift-fox-home.correct: That's right! Swift foxes are adapted to the open shortgrass prairie of southeastern Alberta.
swift-fox-home.tryAgain: Not quite. Look for an open, dry grassland habitat in southern Alberta.

options.small-animals-and-plants: Small animals and plants, including fruit

red-fox-food.correct: That's right! Red foxes eat a varied diet that includes small animals and plant foods such as fruit.
red-fox-food.tryAgain: Not quite. Red foxes eat a varied diet, including both animal and plant foods.

red-fox-sound-identification.prompt: Which animal is making this sound?
red-fox-sound-identification.correct: That's right! You heard the sound of a red fox.
red-fox-sound-identification.tryAgain: Listen closely to the recording and try again.

complete.title: Quiz complete!
complete.description: You explored the habitats, diets, and sounds of Alberta's swift and red foxes.
